items.title: Crypto stocks surge as Bitcoin short squeeze hits record $2.7B
items.summary: Investing.com -- A record $2.7 billion in bearish crypto bets were wiped out in a single 24-hour window on Wednesday, the largest short liquidation event in records going back to 2021, sending Bitcoin to its highest level since early June and lifting crypto-linked equities sharply.

items.title: Bitcoin Roars Past $70,000 as Yields Sink, Trump Sparks Optimism
items.summary: Bitcoin surpassed $70,000 for the first time in over two months, propelled by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's successful move to push US bond yields lower and a high-stakes meeting President Donald Trump held with industry leaders.

items.title: MSTR Stock Climbs As Bitcoin Surges Past $69K For First Time Since June: Trump Urges Congress To Pass CLARITY Act
items.summary: Bitcoin prices surged above $69,000 for the first time since early June after President Donald Trump met with top crypto executives in the White House.
